narrative.overview: The approved animated site application extends the existing identity with a brief brand introduction followed by focused questions, review and explicit submission. The original MegaLinks logo and approved website-to-earnings illustration accompany navy, ice, white and teal-to-blue actions. Local Rubik regular and bold provide the Hebrew hierarchy for this surface only.

rules.name: The Journey Scope Rule
rules.body: Apply the `site-journey-*` system only to the customer site application and its containing dialog; shared seller and administrative surfaces retain their existing typography and palette owners.

dos: Preserve seven original fields, full review, explicit final submission and original approval owners.
Keep RTL labels/actions, LTR URL/email values, full-value wrapping and reachable controls.
donts: Do not upload or submit during navigation, review or edit cancellation.
Do not extend these scoped tokens or motion to other surfaces.

narrative.overview:
The approved administration system puts real records and editing space first.
Opaque white panels sit on an ice ground with faint existing waves, beneath the
Mega Links navy header. Blue actions, measured spacing and Heebo Hebrew type
make the operating surface feel like the approved article editor.

This is an admin-scoped system change. It supersedes earlier administrative rail,
glass-panel, radius and density guidance below; catalog, customer, supplier and
public knowledge styling retain their existing owners. Runtime CSS remains
canonical (model B): `app/admin-editorial.css` refines
`app/admin-approved-glass.css` only while the authenticated editorial admin
surface is present. The `admin-editorial-*` frontmatter entries mirror that scope
and do not replace global tokens. Surface composition and verification boundaries
live in `.impeccable/surfaces/admin-editorial.md`.
keyCharacteristics: A complete searchable header menu and an uninterrupted desktop work surface.
White editorial panels, faint ice waves, blue primary actions and navy titles.
Hebrew RTL with existing Heebo, original record content and explicit actions.
The approved mobile update feed and five-destination pill dock remain familiar.

rules.name: The Scope Rule
rules.body: Administrative editorial tokens apply only to authenticated administration and its currently mounted portals; never replace customer, supplier or public catalog brand tokens with them.

dos: **Do** preserve every administrative destination, field, operation and real record while applying the scoped editorial hierarchy.
**Do** use the existing Heebo font, Hebrew RTL, explicit primary actions and readable field/table typography.
**Do** keep mobile record actions clear of the five-item dock and preserve the existing complete searchable menu at every width.
donts: **Don't** restore a persistent desktop navigation rail in the editorial system.
**Don't** replace global brand tokens, business statuses, permissions, finance calculations or save owners through presentation styling.
**Don't** ship generated mock records, claims or illustrative amounts as data.
